Turn-based combat meets resource management. 3 days to explore the wicked town of Prehevil and find out about its dark secrets. 3 days until the pale and sickly green moon rises at its apex. Termina is upon us!
tagline.en: F&H 2: Termina is oppressive, relentless and hopeless. A mix of jRPG and Survival Horror. Turn-based combat meets resource management. 3 days to explore the wicked town of Prehevil and find out about its dark secrets. 3 days until the pale and sickly green moon rises at its apex. Termina is upon us!

tagline.fr: Tiny Glade est un jeu relaxant dans lequel on érige des châteaux. Découvrez un système de construction sans grille et regardez le jeu assembler briques, planches et pierres. Pas de gestion, pas de combat, pas de mauvaises approches : détendez-vous en transformant des prairies en jolis dioramas.
tagline.en: Tiny Glade is a small diorama builder where you doodle whimsical castles, cozy cottages & romantic ruins. Explore gridless building chemistry as the game adorns your glades with procedural detail. No management, combat or goals: just kick back and turn forgotten meadows into lovable dioramas.

tagline.fr: Des hordes de monstres vous attendent dans ce roguelite effréné. Arpentez les salles du tourment et vainquez leurs terrifiants seigneurs grâce aux trésors, talismans et personnages héroïques que vous déverrouillez en chemin. Combien de temps survivrez-vous dans les profondeurs ?
tagline.en: Slay hordes of terrifying monsters in this horde survival roguelite. Descend into the Halls of Torment where the Lords of the underworld await you. Treasures, magical trinkets, and a growing cast of heroes will grant you the power to vanquish these horrors from beyond. How long can you survive?

tagline.fr: Pizza Tower est un jeu de plateforme en 2D au rythme effréné basé sur le mouvement, l'exploration et la recherche constante du meilleur score. Le jeu inclut des graphismes en pixel stylisés comme jamais et inspirés des cartoons des années 90, ainsi qu'une BO énervée.
tagline.en: Pizza Tower is a fast paced 2D platformer, with an emphasis on movement, exploration and score attack. Featuring highly stylized pixel art inspired by the cartoons from the '90s, and a highly energetic soundtrack.

tagline.fr: Chillquarium est un jeu incrémental relaxant. Achetez des poissons et élevez-les en temps réel, puis vendez-les pour réaliser des bénéfices ! Passez du simple modèle de départ à l'aquarium de vos rêves à mesure que vous collectionnez poissons exotiques et variantes colorées ultrarares !
tagline.en: Chillquarium is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy fish and raise them in real time, then sell them to turn a profit! Customize your aquarium as you progress from a simple starter tank to your dream setup by filling your collection with rare exotic fish and ultra-rare color variants!

tagline.fr: In Felvidek, a JRPG set in 15th century Slovakia, you embrace the role of an alcoholic knight Pavol. Meet diverse and interesting characters to help you drive out the Hussites and Ottomans who blight this land.
tagline.en: In Felvidek, a JRPG set in 15th century Slovakia, you embrace the role of an alcoholic knight Pavol. Meet diverse and interesting characters to help you drive out the Hussites and Ottomans who blight this land.

tagline.fr: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR est un auto-shooter solo style "survivor". Vainquez des hordes d'aliens mortels, minez des richesses, et débloquez de puissantes améliorations pour survivre, en utilisant l'arsenal complet de Deep Rock Galactic. C'est un nain contre toute la planète Hoxxes !
tagline.en: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades to survive, as you wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!

tagline.fr: Un jeu de poker roguelike. Balatro est un jeu de deckbuilding prenant où vous jouez des combinaisons de poker illégales, découvrez des jokers révolutionnaires et déclenchez des combos aussi palpitants que dévastateurs.
tagline.en: The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.

tagline.fr: Un jeu de combat automatique avec gestion d'inventaire en PvP ! Achetez et fabriquez de puissants objets, puis rangez-les soigneusement dans votre sac à dos.
tagline.en: A PvP inventory management auto battler! Buy and craft powerful items, then carefully arrange them in your backpack.

tagline.fr: Plasmatic est un jeu rapide de logique où l'IA, SPIRIT, vous guide à travers des énigmes chronométrées de difficulté croissante. Découvrez des histoires captivantes et forgez votre propre fin.
tagline.en: Plasmatic is a puzzle-solving game where every level is a race against the clock. Follow the clues provided by an AI named SPIRIT, who will guide you through a series of increasingly difficult puzzles. Discover new levels, unfold the story, and decide its ending for yourself.

tagline.fr: Les cinq membres d'équipage du Tulpar se retrouvent coincés aux confins de l'espace, plongés dans un crépuscule perpétuel. Dieu les a abandonnés.
tagline.en: The five crew members of the Tulpar are stranded in the empty reaches of space, shrouded in perpetual sunset. God is not watching.

tagline.fr: Cardverse is a fun card game that will challenge your imagination. Dive into a world filled with unique works of art. Explore with your friends. Simple rules, endless fun, and encouraging creative thinking.
tagline.en: Cardverse is a fun card game that will challenge your imagination. Dive into a world filled with unique works of art. Explore with your friends. Simple rules, endless fun, and encouraging creative thinking.

tagline.fr: Gérez votre supermarché : approvisionnez, fixez les prix, encaissez, embauchez, agrandissez, luttez contre le vol, organisez l’espace, achetez en ligne ou au marché, et livrez les commandes vous-même !
tagline.en: Run your own supermarket! Stock shelves, set your prices, take payments, hire staff, expand your store, handle shoplifters, and design your layout. Purchase goods from online or local markets around town, and personally deliver online orders to your customers.

2751490.title: 吞食拜天地：三国刘蓓传（The legend of Liu Bei of the Three Kingdoms）

tagline.fr: It's a traditional turn-based Japanese RPG! The game starts with the "Liu Bei" Yellow Turban Uprising, goes through the battle of Chibi, collects Xichuan, and ends with the end of the world as the story line... The overall gameplay is about 20 hours!
tagline.en: It's a traditional turn-based Japanese RPG! The game starts with the "Liu Bei" Yellow Turban Uprising, goes through the battle of Chibi, collects Xichuan, and ends with the end of the world as the story line... The overall gameplay is about 20 hours!

tagline.fr: SymbioPhobiA est un court jeu d’horreur de survie, principalement d’un point de vue isométrique qui mélange action, exploration, énigmes et plate-forme qui se déroule dans un bunker futuriste et post-apocalyptique à l’atmosphère oppressante et claustrophobe.
tagline.en: SymbioPhobiA is a short survival horror game, mainly from an isometric perspective that mixes action, exploration, puzzles and platforming that takes place in a futuristic and post-apocalyptic bunker that has an oppressive and claustrophobic atmosphere.

tagline.fr: Jouez à la roulette russe avec une arme de calibre 12. Quatre personnes entrent. Une seule sort. Jouez votre vie avec des dés. Bonne chance.
tagline.en: Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!
